_comment: Accepted instruction-count increases (#944). A PR that makes a kernel deliberately costlier adds the kernel here, with max_ir mapping each configuration it makes costlier (native, native-fast, native-arm64, native-fast-arm64) to the count that configuration's job measured (its job summary prints it), and the reason. The gate then passes that kernel up to max_ir. After the merge the new main baseline carries the count, and the entry is reported as stale; remove it in a later PR. See benchmarks/regression/README.md.
